client_requirement: A real Minecraft Java 26.1.2 client must connect through the repo-native Gradle runClient adapter to a fresh world generated from playable.toml with seed 712816.

steps: Start Solaris from playable.toml with an isolated fresh world and seed 712816.
Connect one real Minecraft Java 26.1.2 client to 127.0.0.1:25565.
Wait until the client reaches Play and generated spawn chunks are visible.
Capture a screenshot after terrain and the player HUD render.
expected_observations: The effective server.toml records seed = 712816 and a per-run world directory.
The client reaches Play without debug commands or operator privileges.
Generated terrain and the player HUD render in a valid screenshot.

evidence_boundary: This preflight proves graphical startup and rendered spawn on the exact seed. It does not replace the owner's subjective terrain/playability disposition, ordinary traversal, restart/rejoin, or release-host throughput gates.
